pages.brief: Olive the owl straining to push a large log on top of a compost heap by herself, the log not moving.
Olive the owl stepping back from a large log, looking around the garden for help.
Olive the owl waving a wing to call Moss the hedgehog over towards the compost heap.
Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog pushing a large log together from opposite sides on the compost heap.
A large log tipping over on the compost heap as Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog watch closely.
Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog looking happily into a cosy hollow under a moved log, pleased with their teamwork.
